steps.text: Clean water is precious and limited, so we must use it wisely. Let's explore ways to save water.
Tap a method to learn how it helps — start with “Rainwater harvesting”.
Rainwater harvesting collects rain to use later and refills groundwater. Other ways: fix leaks, turn off taps, and reuse water where you can.
Every drop counts. Simple habits at home plus methods like rainwater harvesting protect our water for the future.

whenStuck: Tap each method to see how it saves water.
